Ident.description: An identifier: non-empty, one line (no control character U+0000 to U+001F or U+007F to U+009F), without leading or trailing white space (the Unicode White_Space set); interior spaces are allowed (doc 05 §3.2). JSON Schema cannot express Unicode Normalization Form C; the reader rejects non-NFC text.

description:
One cabinet or bayed suite (doc 03 §16, rank 50, `layout/<own id>.jsonl`; FR-LAY-001): the anchor of every
other layout record. At the MVP a location holds at most one layout space (WP-S4.01 D3, refused by
`layout.space.create`, reported by EW-LAY-010 on loaded data).

$k.description: The kind name; always the first member.

id.description: The record ID; it names the layout file.

location.description:
The location structure node the space lays out (+J-E-2416); deleting the node is refused while the space
exists (delete policy forbid).

name.description: The display name; absent: none was given (the views show the location).

title: layout_space
